explanation: regionalSummary ranks regions by their pooled value (falling back to the donor mean without one) and carries an unassigned flag instead of compartment and sparse; donors are still counted once across regions. The Visium tile ranks the top five regional clusters other than Unassigned, draws a bar at the pooled value and a dot per donor, and explains the pooling; the sparse style is removed from search.css. Region names, the absence of a minimum-spot or sparse rule, and pooling every spot to summarise a region follow the HYPOMAP authors (Tadross et al. 2025, Supplementary Table 20 and Methods). visiumSectionIndex.ts loads and validates sections/index.json (image files must be regions/ or <GENE>/section-<n>.webp under the sections root, colours #RRGGBB, labels inside their frame) and builds release-versioned image URLs; VisiumSections.tsx adds the tile button "<GENE> on all 9 sections" opening the shared Modal with each section as a labelled regional-cluster map beside the gene, a colour bar, a cluster legend and the credit, and names the curated genes for any other measured gene.
